parsed.explanation: Worst exposure is a Tier-1 universal rule: birth-sex use of restrooms/locker rooms in schools and all government buildings, enforced via a public reporting/complaint form, with a defence requiring birth-certificate/surgery records a visitor will not carry and no route for out-of-jurisdiction documents. Nationally, entry screening can refuse visas on sex-document discrepancy, with a possible permanent fraud ineligibility finding, and passport confiscation/stranding is reported. National custody records document birth-sex-based denial of hormones/conversion practices and severe abuse in immigration detention, though detention of a visitor is conditional. Private hotels/businesses are exempt, courts have enjoined some national orders and hear passport litigation, hate-crime law covers gender identity, and state documents remain amendable - functioning recourse, but not shown to remedy the facility/border rules. This is unremedied institutional exclusion with added border/custody severity, below the 0.45 tier and above organised targeting.
